items.title: prefight-reference-access
items.claim: Image #2 shows the qualifier instructions and Fight button without a visible Moves control, whereas Image #3 includes Moves.
items.reason: New players need the command reference alongside the introductory instructions.
items.suggest: Add a Techniques button beside Fight that opens the existing reference screen.

items.title: countdown-reading-pressure
items.claim: Image #2 displays STARTING IN 7 beneath Fight while presenting instructions, and Image #8 displays STARTING IN 8 beneath Rematch.
items.reason: The wording signals a deadline for reading instructions or reviewing results; these stills cannot establish what happens when the countdown expires.
items.suggest: Make these decision screens player-paced and remove the countdown text; first capture countdown expiry to determine whether this requires a logic change or only a copy change.

items.title: technique-hint-mapping
items.claim: Image #3 labels the technique directions back, forward, up and down, while Image #6 additionally identifies their meanings as reverse, punch, kick and sweep.
items.reason: The in-fight hint omits the action mapping that the reference provides, making beginners memorize it.
items.suggest: Use Forward: punch, Back: reverse, Up: kick and Down: sweep in the technique hint, wrapping the labels rather than shrinking them.

items.title: point-call-explanation
items.claim: The IPPON banner in Image #17 and WAZA-ARI banner in Image #20 identify the fighter and technique but do not explicitly state the awarded point value.
items.reason: Players unfamiliar with the terminology must consult the scoreboard or reference to understand the call.
items.suggest: Add Full point or Half point to the banner, derived from the actual scoring event, while retaining the Japanese call.

items.title: settings-backdrop-cutoff
items.claim: In Images #7 and #16, the opaque settings surface ends partway down the screen, hiding the fighters' upper bodies while leaving their lower bodies visible beneath it.
items.reason: The abrupt partial reveal distracts from the settings and makes the overlay feel visually unfinished.
items.suggest: Extend the opaque settings surface to the full viewport height, with scrollable content and a persistently available Close control.
